scripts.test:e2e: bddgen && pnpm run check:suite && playwright test
scripts.test:local: bddgen -c playwright.local.config.ts && pnpm run check:local && playwright test --config playwright.local.config.ts
scripts.e2e:ui:local: bddgen -c playwright.local.config.ts && pnpm run check:local && playwright test --config playwright.local.config.ts --ui
scripts.clean: rm -rf .features-gen .features-gen-local playwright-report playwright-report-local test-results test-results-local .turbo node_modules
